description: This file defines the 'Certificates' React component, which renders a page displaying a list of certificates, allowing the user to preview and export them as PNG or PDF. It includes internal logic for date formatting, handling modal dialogs for previews, and exporting functionalities.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date string into a localized date string, with fallback to original if parsing fails.

methods.name: handleOpenPreview
methods.description: Sets the state to display the certificate preview modal.

methods.name: handleClosePreview
methods.description: Resets the preview state to close the modal.

methods.name: handleDownloadPng
methods.description: Exports the certificate preview as a PNG file, generating a filename based on course title and certificate ID.

methods.name: handleDownloadPdf
methods.description: Exports the certificate preview as a PDF, similar to PNG export, with specific options.

methods.name: slugify
methods.description: Creates a URL/filename-friendly string from the course title.
